paragraphs.text:
You  emerge  with  your  students  to  survey  the  slaughter. 
Although heavy, a dire wolf’s head would be convincing proof 
of  your  discoveries.  Sylvia  prepares  it  for  transport  back  to 
civilization.
Record the keyword BACKWATER. Go to 652.
